1: // Simple Bouncing Ball game
2: // Targets <canvas id="game"> element
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) {
7:     console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
8:     return;
9:   }
10:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
11: 
12:   // Resize canvas to fill its container
13:   const resize = () => {
14:     canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
15:     canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
16:   };
17:   resize();
18:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
19: 
20:   // Ball properties
21:   const ball = {
22:     // properties
23:   };
24: 
25:   // Audio context for bounce sound (lazy init)
26:   let audioCtx;
27:   function playBounce() {
28:     if (!audioCtx) {
29:       audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
30:     }
31:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
32:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
33:     osc.type = 'sine';
34:     osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(200, audioCtx.currentTime);
35:     osc.connect(gain);
36:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
37:     osc.start();
38:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.1);
39:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.1);
40:   }
41: 
42:   // Ball properties
43:     x: canvas.width / 2,
44:     y: canvas.height / 2,
45:     vx: 200, // pixels per second
46:     vy: 150,
47:     radius: 15,
48:     color: '#ff6600',
49:   };
50: 
51:   let lastTime = performance.now();
52: 
53:   function update(dt) {
54:     ball.x += ball.vx * dt;
55:     ball.y += ball.vy * dt;
56: 
57:     // Bounce off walls
58:     if (ball.x - ball.radius < 0) {
59:       ball.x = ball.radius;
60:       ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx);
61:       playBounce();
62:     } else if (ball.x + ball.radius > canvas.width) {
63:       ball.x = canvas.width - ball.radius;
64:       ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx);
65:     }
66:     if (ball.y - ball.radius < 0) {
67:       ball.y = ball.radius;
68:       ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy);
69:       playBounce();
70:     } else if (ball.y + ball.radius > canvas.height) {
71:       ball.y = canvas.height - ball.radius;
72:       ball.vy = -Math.abs(ball.vy);
73:       playBounce();
74:     }
75:   }
76: 
77:   function draw() {
78:     // Draw a dark gradient background
79:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
80:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001d3d');
81:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000814');
82:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
83:     // Use slight opacity to create motion trail effect
84:     ctx.globalAlpha = 0.8;
85:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
86:     ctx.globalAlpha = 1.0;
87: 
88:     // Draw ball with radial gradient for a shiny look
89:     const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
90:       ball.x - ball.radius / 3,
91:       ball.y - ball.radius / 3,
92:       ball.radius / 5,
93:       ball.x,
94:       ball.y,
95:       ball.radius
96:     );
97:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#ffcc66');
98:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#ff6600');
99:     ctx.beginPath();
100:     ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
101:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
102:     ctx.fill();
103:     // Optional subtle shadow
104:     ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
105:     ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
106:     ctx.shadowOffsetX = 2;
107:     ctx.shadowOffsetY = 2;
108:     ctx.fill();
109:     // Reset shadow for next frame
110:     ctx.shadowColor = 'transparent';
111:   }
112: 
113:   function loop(timestamp) {
114:     const dt = (timestamp - lastTime) / 1000; // seconds
115:     lastTime = timestamp;
116:     update(dt);
117:     draw();
118:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
119:   }
120: 
121:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
122: })();
